description: This PHP script handles the import of test execution results from an XML file in the TestLink open-source test management tool. It includes functions for loading XML files, validating their structure, parsing test case execution data, and saving the results into the database, including steps, bugs, and custom fields. The script also manages file uploads, user sessions, and GUI initialization for the import process.

methods.name: importExecutionResultsFromXML
methods.description: Loads an XML file and imports execution results if valid XML structure is detected.

methods.name: importResults
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract test execution information and saves it into the database.

methods.name: saveImportedResultData
methods.description: Saves parsed test execution data into the database, including steps, bugs, and custom fields.

methods.name: importExecutionsFromXML
methods.description: Imports multiple test case executions from an XML set.

methods.name: importExecutionFromXML
methods.description: Imports individual test case execution details from an XML element.

methods.name: check_xml_execution_results
methods.description: Validates the structure of the XML file to ensure it conforms to expected 'results' format.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters for the import process.

methods.name: check_exec_values
methods.description: Validates execution data fields such as test case ID, timestamp, tester, bug IDs, and execution type.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI parameters and display strings for the import page.
